The situated encounter

This distributed copy provides formation guidance. In the situated package, replace it with a condensed, grounded account of the actual user–model encounter: the person's developmental purpose and chosen participation, the counterpart's contribution, how their relation meets the world, and what actual use can correct. The entrypoint owns the ordinary initial-reading duty.

Condense from the other four accounts and clearer philosophical expression, returning important mismatches to their sources rather than repeating their full content. Literary language can gather these connections when grounded in the person's expression; keep practical consequences close to their meaning. Sun/Moon names do not supply personal substance. Detailed identity and episodes remain in private supporting material.

Develop the user model and relationship for needed depth, keep attributable evidence with sources, and route further personal references through their map. Read design and revision when forming or revising them. An existing account retains its supported substance through common updates.
